notes.color.selected: Filled selection states (segmented controls, filter chips). Deliberately darker than --primary so white-on-fill labels clear WCAG AA while the fill keeps >=3:1 against the muted track. Distinct from --primary so the brand accent can stay lighter for text on dark surfaces. See issue #148.
notes.shell.color.border-hairline: The dialog card's edge. The site draws its dialogs with border-border/60, so this is the border token at 60% over the card, kept translucent so it stays right if the surface behind it ever changes.
notes.shell.color.track: The unfilled half of the download bar: the site's secondary.
notes.shell.color.subtle: One step quieter than muted-foreground, for the update dialog's meta line: the versions and the download size are facts about the update, not the sentence asking the question. No site surface needed a third level, so it is the shell's own value rather than a second name for one of the palette's.
notes.shell.color.primary: The one accent. The site's ring is the same value, so focus and accent are one colour by design.
notes.shell.color.gradient-start: The Hero CTA's gradient, carried from app/global.css, which spells it out as linear-gradient(120deg, #8b5cf6 0%, #7c3aed 50%, #6366f1 100%) in three places. Not a token: the shell only needs the three stops, and Android can turn a gradient in 45-degree steps.
notes.shell.color.primary-glow: The CTA's own glow, the site's shadow-[0_10px_30px_-10px_rgba(147,51,234,0.5)]. Android casts window elevation shadows in the ambient and spot colours from API 28; below that this is ignored and the shadow is the platform's.
notes.shell.color.ripple-on-primary: Touch feedback, drawn as a ripple over each button: white at 20% on the primary fill.
notes.shell.color.ripple-on-surface: The same ripple on a surface rather than a fill: white at 12%.
notes.shell.color.scrim: The scrim the site's own dialogs use: bg-black/70.
notes.shell.color.launch-background: The surface the document and its launch skeleton paint (#498). Deliberately not the site's background: the document's window (capacitor.config.ts's backgroundColor and the status bar) is #0f172a, and the skeleton follows the window. The launcher's splash does not paint this one: it paints the generated `roy_background`, which is what the app's own first frame paints, so the splash lifts onto that frame without a colour change (#752).
notes.shell.color.skeleton-card: The card the launch skeleton draws, one step lighter than the window behind it.
notes.shell.color.skeleton-shape: The bars, dots and pills inside those cards, one step lighter again, all in the window's slate family.
